boxes.title: Dynasties: added detail
items: Eastern Chalukyas merged with the Cholas under **Kulottunga I** (**1070**)
Reddis from **1325**; capital shifted to Kondavidu by ==**Anavema Reddy**==; later **Rajahmundry** branch
Golconda old name ==**Mankal / Mangalavaram**==; **7** sultans; Hyderabad capital (some notes: from **1592**); people spoke **Telugu**

boxes.title: Contests & battles: more
items: Raichur Doab: ==fertile **black soil**==, strategic; **Adil Khan** held it at Krishnadevaraya's accession
Coast: three-way contest of **Gajapatis, Vijayanagara, Bahmanis** (plus Reddis, Velamas)
Kapaya's son **Vinayaka** killed → Golconda fort ceded
**Sultan Quli** annexed ==**Rajahmundry, Eluru**== and the K-G region

boxes.title: Other regional sequences
head: Region
Sequence
rows: Kakatiyas → ==Delhi Sultanate (1323)== → Musunuri → Velamas / Bahmanis → Qutb Shahis

boxes.title: Significance & current
items: ==**1323**== = end of Telugu imperial unity until the Qutb Shahis
New **Seshachalam** inscriptions, **16th c.** → ==**Tuluva or early Aravidu**== period
CE dynasties also include **Kalyani Chalukyas**, **Potapi Cholas**
